components.name: Arrow
components.description: Draw an arrow.

components.name: VDragArrow
components.description: An Arrow component that can be dragged.

components.name: AutoFitText
components.description: Box inside which the font size automatically adapts to fit the content. Similar to a PowerPoint or Keynote TextBox. (Experimental)

components.name: LightOrDark
components.description: Display one thing or another depending on the active light or dark theme, via the #dark and #light slots. Extra props are passed through as scoped slot props.

components.name: Link
components.description: Insert a link you can use to navigate to a given slide.

props.name: to
props.description: The path of the slide to navigate to (slide paths start from 1); a string navigates to a routeAlias

components.name: PoweredBySlidev
components.description: Renders "Powered by Slidev" with a link to the Slidev website.

components.name: RenderWhen
components.description: Render slots depending on whether the context matches (for example whether we are in presenter view). The #default slot renders on match, #fallback otherwise.

props.name: context
props.description: a context or array of contexts to check for: 'main' | 'visible' | 'print' | 'slide' | 'overview' | 'presenter' | 'previewNext'

components.name: SlideCurrentNo
components.description: Current slide number.

components.name: SlidesTotal
components.description: Total number of slides.

components.name: Toc
components.description: Insert a Table Of Contents. Slides with hideInToc: true in their frontmatter are skipped.

props.name: columns
props.description: The number of columns of the display

props.name: listClass
props.description: Classes to apply to the table of contents list

props.name: maxDepth
props.description: The maximum depth level of title to display

props.name: minDepth
props.description: The minimum depth level of title to display

props.name: mode
props.description: 'all' displays all items, 'onlyCurrentTree' only items in the current tree, 'onlySiblings' only items in the current tree and their direct siblings

components.name: Transform
components.description: Apply scaling or transforming to elements.

components.name: Tweet
components.description: Embed a tweet.

components.name: BlueSky
components.description: Embed a Bluesky post.

props.name: uri
props.description: AT-URI of the Bluesky post, or a https://bsky.app/profile/.../post/... URL

components.name: VAfter
components.description: Click animation: show the wrapped element after the previous v-click element.

components.name: VClick
components.description: Click animation: show the wrapped element after a click.

props.name: at
props.description: the click turn to show the element at; '+n' is relative

props.name: hide
props.description: hide the element after the click instead of showing it

components.name: VClicks
components.description: Click animation: apply a click animation to every direct child (handy for lists).

props.name: depth
props.description: nesting depth of list items to animate

props.name: every
props.description: number of children to reveal per click

props.name: at
props.description: the click turn to start at; '+n' is relative

props.name: hide
props.description: hide the elements after the click instead of showing them

components.name: VSwitch
components.description: Switch between multiple slots based on clicks.

props.name: at
props.description: the click turn to start at; '+n' is relative

props.name: unmount
props.description: unmount the previous slot when switching to the next slot

props.name: tag
props.description: tag of the component root element

components.name: VDrag
components.description: Make the wrapped element draggable in the slide.

components.name: SlidevVideo
components.description: Embed a video.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: true or 'once' starts the video once without restarting it when ended or paused

props.name: autoreset
props.description: go back to the start of the video when going back to the slide or to the component's click turn

props.name: poster
props.description: The source of the image to print when the video is not playing

props.name: printPoster
props.description: The override for poster when printing

props.name: timestamp
props.description: The starting time of the video in seconds

props.name: printTimestamp
props.description: The override for timestamp when printing

components.name: Youtube
components.description: Embed a YouTube video. Add ?start=1234 to the id value to start at a specific time (in seconds).

directives.name: v-click
directives.description: Click animation: show the element after a click. Accepts a click turn value, e.g. v-click="3" or v-click="'+2'".

directives.name: v-after
directives.description: Click animation: show the element at the same click turn as the previous v-click element.

directives.name: v-motion
directives.description: Apply motion animations to the element (powered by @vueuse/motion), e.g. :initial / :enter / :leave variant objects.

directives.name: v-mark
directives.description: Rough Notation marker: underline, circle, or highlight the element, optionally bound to a click turn, e.g. v-mark.underline.orange.

directives.name: v-drag
directives.description: Make the element draggable in the slide; the position is persisted into the markdown.
